info.name: Space-Track Ancillary Tracking and Impact Prediction API
Query Tracking and Impact Prediction (TIP) messages

params.name: queryParams
params.description: Flexible REST query path segments. Format: /FIELD/VALUE/FIELD2/VALUE2/format/FORMAT/. Supports operators: range (--), greater-than (%3E), less-than (%3C), null (null-val), comma lists. Example: /NORAD_CAT_ID/25544/format/json/

items.docs: Returns reentry tracking and impact prediction messages for hazardous debris. Rate limit: 1 per hour normally; 1 per 10 minutes when reentry is within 12 hours.
